why: Two fixed rules were reworded on purpose to name the guideline's action (6def3d7). GLM's saved 2B run holds their old text, and the passages their old text found (a rule alert searches with its own words). The Phase 4 check uses this text and these passages for those fixed-rule alerts only; everything the AI said is compared with the saved run unchanged. Made by replaying the saved run through the backend on 2026-11-27: 9 runs (MR-KS, P003, P005 x 3) differed, only in these two alerts message and passages.

messages.tdf_nsaid_use: NSAID use is mentioned in notes for a patient on TDF; NSAIDs add to kidney harm. Consider stopping or avoiding the NSAID, especially if kidney function is falling (Uganda Clinical Guidelines 2023, p. 452 and p. 625), with paracetamol for pain instead. Check kidney function; if the GFR is below 60 ml/min, consider substituting TDF with ABC (Uganda HIV Guidelines 2022, p. 270).
messages.efv_sleep_disturbance: Sleep disturbance mentioned in notes for a patient on EFV. Reassure first. If the symptoms persist, consider substituting EFV with DTG (or LPV/r if a suitable DTG formulation is not available) (Uganda HIV Guidelines 2022, p. 269).
